_README: Escambia County, Florida (Pensacola). Partially configured.
Filled in below: state, county, category, procedure, and the where-clause
shape. Left as ENDPOINT_REQUIRED and COLUMN_REQUIRED: the dataset URL and
its column names, which cannot be known without reading the live endpoint.
A Socrata dataset is addressed by an opaque four-by-four id and its columns
are named by whoever published it, so writing either from memory is a guess,
and a guessed id returns 404 -- which this pipeline reads as 'no records in
this county' rather than as a broken entry.
To complete it, from a machine with outbound HTTPS:
python scripts/build_jurisdiction_registry.py --states FL --out fl.json
That reads one real row per candidate and writes the columns it observed.
Then prove each entry:  POST /distress-ingest/validate {"jurisdiction_id": ...}
FLORIDA IS A JUDICIAL FORECLOSURE STATE.
Verified against /foreclosure-procedure/states/FL, which returns:
procedure : judicial
offices   : district_or_circuit_court, county_recorder, county_sheriff
documents : lis_pendens, foreclosure_complaint, judgment, sheriff_sale_notice
So there is no Notice of Default and no Notice of Trustee Sale to collect
here; those are non-judicial artefacts. Configuring them for FL is rejected
with a warning by design. In Florida the Clerk of the Circuit Court is both
the court clerk and the county recorder, so the court case and the recorded
lis pendens are held by the same office.
UNVERIFIED: whether Escambia County publishes any of this as a machine-
readable dataset at all. Many Florida clerks expose only a web search page.
If that is the case here, the correct outcome is that this county is
reported unavailable, not scraped -- see the note at the top of
app/distress_providers.py.

jurisdictions._purpose: Judicial pre-foreclosure. The primary distress signal in Florida.
Sheriff sale calendar. In a judicial state the sale follows judgment.
Recorded transfers. Feeds cash-buyer discovery: POST /cash-buyers/sync/escambia-fl-deeds
jurisdictions.where: OPTIONAL date filter; 12-24 months keeps candidates to currently active buyers

_purpose: Mortgages and deeds of trust. Optional, and the only route to a cash
purchase being reported as confirmed rather than unconfirmed.
Scope this with the same date window as the deed feed. /cash-buyers/sync
abandons the cross-reference if this index comes back at the row cap,
because an address missing from a truncated read is not an address with
jurisdictions.where: OPTIONAL filter matching the deed feed's window

jurisdictions._purpose: Tax delinquency. Independent of foreclosure procedure; Florida sells tax certificates.
